baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object suffix in جَعَلْنَاهُنَّ is followed by accusative أَبْكَارًا; ج ع ل B002 and ب ك ر B004 support a produced result-state.
baseline_models.mechanism: Resultative making acts on the feminine plural object and installs non-contact as its state rather than merely naming an inherent class.

activation_trace.role: Rendering something into a state supplies the causative result frame.
Virginity and non-contact supply the state produced by the making.

changed_reading.before: They are simply identified as virgins.
changed_reading.after: They are deliberately rendered into an untouched state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Within the resultative construction, ب ك ر B002 carries the first of a thing, first-fruit, recent occurrence, and what has not been repeated.
baseline_models.mechanism: The predicate can mark conferred incipience: the plural object is made newly at a first state, not only classified by prior sexual history.

activation_trace.role: State-rendering makes firstness an effected condition.
First-fruit and newly occurred firstness supply an inaugural freshness.

changed_reading.before: أَبْكَارًا is limited to sexual untouchedness.
changed_reading.after: It can also present them as made newly first, fresh, and inaugural.

context_deltas.mechanism: The doubled creation expression immediately before the focus supplies origination; the following resultative making then produces firstness or untouchedness as a distinct outcome. The state is conferred after emergence rather than merely preserved from a past.

activation_trace.role: Bringing a thing into being supplies the prior origination stage.
Rendering into a state supplies the second-stage operation.
Newly occurred firstness names the outcome installed after origination.
Untouchedness keeps the ordinary virginity branch live inside the renewed state.

structural_cues: 56:35 immediately precedes the focus, repeats ن ش ء as verb and cognate noun, and carries the same feminine plural object; 56:36 opens with fa.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origination followed by state-making; I infer an origination-to-conferred-firstness arrow. A live alternative is that 56:36 simply specifies the single creative act in 56:35 rather than marking a second operation.

changed_reading.before: Their virginity or freshness is an original biographical fact.
changed_reading.after: After being originated, they are actively made first and untouched afresh.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden sequence couples prolonged duration and growing abundance with the explicit negation of ending and obstruction. Transferred to the focus predicate, the first-fruit branch becomes a condition whose inaugural freshness is neither exhausted nor withheld.

activation_trace.role: State-rendering installs durability as part of the produced condition.
First-fruit and recent occurrence supply the freshness that can be continually renewed.
Prolonged time supplies persistence rather than a momentary first state.
Numerical growth supplies replenishing abundance.
Ending and disappearance, negated in the source, supply non-expiry.
A barrier to what is desired, negated in the source, supplies unobstructed availability.

structural_cues: From 56:28 through 56:34 the list repeatedly modifies ordinary goods, then pairs two negations immediately before the creation sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prolonged, abundant, non-ending, unobstructed provision; I transfer that anti-depletion pattern to the focus predicate's first-fruit image. The live alternative is that these properties remain environmental setting and do not qualify the made state.

changed_reading.before: Firstness is a one-time condition that ordinary duration consumes.
changed_reading.after: They are made perpetually first-fresh, an inaugural condition that does not run out or become barred.

context_deltas.mechanism: A repeated companionship-and-blessing frame encloses the scene, while the following predicates supply active love and equality of age and companionship. Made firstness thus functions as a reset into mutually matched relationship, not as an isolated bodily status.

activation_trace.role: State-rendering configures a relational condition rather than merely attaching a label.
Non-contact supplies the reset whose social purpose is specified by neighboring predicates.
Repeated companionship and abiding together open the social frame.
Blessing gives the companionship frame its affirmative value.
The loving woman image supplies active affection rather than passive status.
Equality in age and companionship supplies mutual parity.
The returning companionship term closes the social allocation around the made state.
The returning blessing term closes the affirmative frame.

structural_cues: The identical صاحب/يمين pair occurs at 56:27 and 56:38, while the three accusative predicates in 56:36-37 form one compact descriptive sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies companionship, blessing, love, and coeval equality; I infer that the made first-state enables a reciprocal matched relation. A live alternative is that these are adjacent but independent attributes and that the recipient companions are not relational counterparts of the feminine object.

changed_reading.before: They are made virgins as passive bearers of a private purity status.
changed_reading.after: They are made into a renewed, loving, coeval companionship configuration under a blessing frame.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parallel gathered cohorts from the first and the later periods both follow the allocation line. Their temporal opposition tests the focus predicate: firstness can be bestowed across historical positions and therefore need not mean chronological precedence.

activation_trace.role: State-rendering allows firstness to be bestowed independently of prior chronology.
The first or newly occurred image supplies conferred temporal beginning.
A gathered group supplies collective distribution of the made state.
Beginning and precedence supply the early temporal pole.
The second gathered group repeats collective distribution at the other temporal pole.
Laterness after the first supplies the late temporal pole.

structural_cues: 56:39 and 56:40 are parallel clauses differing in first-versus-later designation and immediately follow the allocation in 56:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel early and late recipient cohorts; I infer through 56:38 that the focus-created condition is available across both, converting firstness from historical rank into bestowed state. The live alternative is that the cohort lines only quantify recipients and do not temporalize أَبْكَارًا.

changed_reading.before: Fresh firstness belongs naturally to what comes earliest.
changed_reading.after: The same first-state can be conferred on gathered cohorts whether historically first or later.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts from untouchedness to natal sequence and uses an animal-gestation branch. It remains anchored in ب ك ر B005 and the adjacent ن ش ء B009 conception image; downstream prose should present it only as a reproductive emergence analogy, not as the lexical translation of أَبْكَارًا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ب ك ر B005 carries first child and first birth, allowing the made state to be heard as inaugural emergence.

activation_trace.role: Conception and gestational growth supply the emergence process.
State-rendering turns inaugural emergence into the conferred outcome.
First child and first birth supply a natal version of firstness.

changed_reading.before: They are restored to a static untouched status.
changed_reading.after: They are made as though each emergence were an inaugural birth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ب ك ر B007 comes from the idiom of arriving on one pulley or one way, not the ordinary morphology of the plural predicate. It remains focus-anchored and gains support from ordered joining, coeval equality, and a gathered group; downstream prose should label it a secondary associative resonance, not translate أَبْكَارًا as a procession.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ب ك ر B007 permits an all-together, one-method, or one-after-another image within the plural focus predicate.

activation_trace.role: Arrival all together, on one way, or in succession supplies synchronized plurality.
Joining one thing to another in order supplies coordinated arrangement.
Equality in age and companionship supplies matching within the cohort.
A gathered group supplies the collective unit moved in one mode.

changed_reading.before: أَبْكَارًا describes separate individuals by virgin status.
changed_reading.after: It also faintly activates a matched cohort configured to arrive together or in ordered succession.

strongest_changes: The preceding doubled origination turns firstness from retained biography into a state deliberately conferred after emergence.
Prolonged, abundant, non-ending, unobstructed provision activates an inexhaustible first-fruit freshness in أَبْكَارًا.
Love, coeval companionship, and early-versus-late cohorts make firstness relational and distributable rather than merely private and chronological.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots allow virginity, first-fruit newness, first birth, and one-mode arrival to coexist. Context repeatedly converts a fixed status into a created, renewable, socially matched, and transhistorically distributable condition.
remaining_uncertainties: The feminine plural referent is not named inside the focus ayah, so the transition from the raised furnishings in 56:34 remains structurally underdetermined.
The loving and coeval predicates may be independent descriptions rather than functional specifications of the made first-state.
The natal and one-mode branches are deliberately retained as exploratory resonances because their morphology and domain are more distant.
